استنظروا (form X)

# اُسْتُنْظِرُوا (ustunẓirū) /us.tun.ðˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# اِسْتَنْظِرُوا (istanẓirū) /is.tan.ðˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
